source: extracted from JJK 5e V.6.txt Chapter 6.2 Feats (Barrier/Cursed Energy/Physical/Skill)

barrier.name: Basic Curtain
barrier.text:
Emerge from the darkness, blacker than darkness. Purify that which
is impure. As an action for 5 Cursed Energy, you cover the sky and
the ground within a 2165-foot radius dome of darkness for 10 minutes.
Upon activation, a dark, almost liquid-like matter drips down from
the sky to form the outer barrier wall in the shape of a half-sphere.
The curtain changes and the sky becomes dark despite the time of day,
provoking any cursed spirits out of hiding. For each extra 1 Cursed
Energy spent, you can add 1 additional minute to the curtain's
duration and +10 hit points. Your curtain has a number of hit points
equal to your Cursed Energy modifier times your level. This barrier
has an AC equal to the caster's Cursed Energy DC and automatically
fails saving throws. It is also immune to Poison and Psychic damage.

barrier.name: Barrier Intruder
barrier.text:
You have learned how to invade the barriers of others without
breaking them. You gain the following benefits:
● While outside a barrier, you can make a Cursed Energy check as
an action against the CE save DC of the sorcerer who created
the barrier to invade it. On a success, you can enter the
barrier although the creator will know a creature has entered.
● While inside a barrier, as an action you can make a Cursed
Energy check against the CE save DC of the sorcerer to alter
its properties. On a success, you can change the creatures
allowed to enter or leave or other properties of the barrier.

barrier.name: Falling Blossom Emotion
barrier.prereq: Must have the Clan Sorcerer Background
barrier.text:
Unlike Simple Domain, which manifests its own domain to protect
against a guaranteed hit, Falling Blossom Emotion shrouds the user in
cursed energy to counterattack the moment a domain's guaranteed hit
makes contact. As an action or reaction for 5 Cursed Energy, you
surround yourself in cursed energy to make any attack or effect with
a guaranteed hit nullified and deal no damage. This technique lasts
for 1 minute, but does not affect attacks without a guaranteed hit.
You can also use this technique offensively while wielding a melee
weapon. As an action for 4 Cursed Energy, you can surround yourself
in cursed energy to prepare for an attack for 1 minute. As a reaction
to an attack, you can make a melee weapon attack at advantage against
the attacker before the attack happens. On a hit, the attack counts
as a critical hit and deals necrotic damage. Once you make this
attack, you must reactivate the technique to use it again. If your
cursed energy or technique alters damage type, it can also alter this
damage

barrier.name: Hollow Wicker Basket
barrier.text:
As an action, bonus action, or reaction against being affected by a
sure hit effect of a Domain, or seeing a Domain Expansion open, for 4
Cursed Energy you surround yourself with a 15 ft barrier for 1
minute. Within that radius, the sure hit effect of a domain is
negated and deals no damage. Anyone of your choice inside the barrier
is unaffected. The barrier has no effect on normal cursed techniques
or others entering the barrier. It only negates sure hit effects.

barrier.name: Incomplete Domain
barrier.text:
You learn to prematurely create an incomplete Domain Expansion. As an
action for 10 cursed energy, you create an unrefined incomplete
domain 100 feet around yourself for 1 minute. This structureless
domain does not follow you, has a refinement of 0, and has no
barrier.
The domain lacks a guaranteed hit, but you gain advantage on
technique attack rolls and creatures inside your domain have
disadvantage on saving throws against your Innate Technique. Any
effects of your domain are halved until you gain your complete Domain
Expansion, upon which you can choose a different feat. When the
domain ends, you experience Technique Burnout for 5 rounds.

barrier.name: Simple Domain
barrier.text:
As an action or reaction against an attack roll or saving throw
effect, spell or domain expansion opening for 4 Cursed Energy, you
surround yourself with a 10 ft barrier for 1 minute. The circle has
an amount of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus times twice
your Cursed Energy modifier. Any damaging cursed techniques, spells,
or attacks that target you or targets an area that overlaps with your
simple domain, will now damage the barrier instead, reducing its hit
points by the damage it would cause. Your Simple Domain ends if you
move.

barrier.name: Refined Domain
barrier.prereq: Must have Domain Expansion, 400 Refinement points
barrier.text:
Your refinement allows you to further empower your domain expansion.
You can choose one of the following benefits:
● Severe Danification. If your domain has a passive effect that
causes damage at Initiative 20, the number of damage dice are
increased by your CE modifier.
● Non-Lethality. If your domain is Non-Lethal or has a
restriction, you can add an additional condition or restriction
to your technique.
● Cost Reduction. Your domain refinement enhances the technique
imbued into the barrier. While within your domain, the CE cost
of your innate technique features are halved(rounded up).
● Lightning Speed Release. Your domain refinement has made your
techniques faster. Your innate technique features action costs
reduced by one while your domain is active (Action > Bonus
Action > Reaction > Free Action).
● Multiplication. Your domain has multiplied the output of the
imbued innate technique. When a feature lets you spend up to a
certain amount of cursed energy, that maximum amount is
doubled.
● Improved Technique. Your imbued technique has been refined.
While within your domain, you can choose one of your Innate
Technique features. The damage dice of that technique increases
by your CE modifier.

ce.name: Bottomless Cursed Energy
ce.prereq: 20+ Cursed Energy Score and a Breakthrough
ce.text:
You have touched both the core of Cursed Energy and the hidden Cursed
Energy within you. Your Cursed Energy maximum increases by an amount
equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain
a level, your Cursed Energy maximum increases by 2 Cursed Energy.

ce.name: Immense Cursed Energy
ce.text:
Your Cursed Energy has massive reserves, making you become a cursed
energy powerhouse. You gain the following benefits:
● You gain a +1 to your Cursed Energy score (maximum of 20).
● Your CE maximum increases by your Cursed Energy modifier.

ce.name: Malevolent Cursed Energy
ce.text:
Your soul is rotten, and your cursed energy shows that. As an action,
you release your cursed energy and creatures within 100 ft must make
a Wisdom saving throw against your cursed energy DC. On a success,
they can feel your cruelty but are not shaken by it. On failure, they
are frightened and receive one of the following detriments for 1
minute:
● They hesitate to act due to your suffocating presence, their
ability checks, saving throws, and attack rolls are reduced by
your Cursed Energy modifier.
● Your power makes them become paralyzed in fear, they have a
disadvantage on your saving throws.
● If the creature's CR or level is equal to or higher than your
level, they make this saving throw with advantage. If the
creature's CR or level is 3 or more below your level, they make
this saving throw with disadvantage.
A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of their turn.
Once a creature passes this saving throw, it becomes immune to this
effect for 24 hours.

ce.name: Cursed Energy Perception
ce.text:
You have learned how to track down remains of cursed energy. You gain
Expertise in Perception if you don't already. You also gain a +5
bonus to checks relating to sensing Cursed Energy and can sense
cursed energy from 90 ft away.

ce.name: Cursed Enhancement
ce.text:
As a bonus action while touching a weapon, you can spend cursed
energy up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to enhance
that weapon. The weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls
for every cursed energy spent (to a maximum of +3) for 1 hour. This
does not stack with a weapon’s bonus if it already has a bonus to
attack and damage rolls.

ce.name: Cursed Imbuement
ce.text:
When attacking with unarmed strikes or a weapon you are proficient
with, you can use your Cursed Energy modifier instead of Strength or
Dexterity for your attack and damage rolls. However, on a roll of
natural one for an attack roll, you must make a Cursed Energy check
against your Cursed Energy DC, or shatter the weapon as you
overcharge it or take 1 necrotic damage if using unarmed strikes.
Additionally, you can spend 1 cursed energy to imbue it into an
object for 1 minute, causing it to deal necrotic damage for the
duration.

ce.name: Curse Enhanced Body
ce.text:
You can enhance your body with Cursed energy. While not wearing
armor, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to your AC. This becomes
half your modifier (rounded up) if you have a feature such as
Unarmored Defense.
Additionally, you can use your Cursed Energy modifier for unarmed
strikes in place of Strength or Dexterity. As a reaction you can
spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier and gain a
bonus to a physical saving throw equal to the cursed energy spent. If
you have Reverse Cursed Technique, you can also use this feature for
mental saving throws.

ce.name: Cursed Energy Slash
ce.text:
As an action while holding a weapon that deals slashing damage, you
can spend 5 Cursed Energy to make a huge cursed energy slash. You
make all creatures in a 15 ft cone or a 30 ft line make a Dexterity
saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes the weapon’s normal
damage + additional damage dice equal to a single die of the weapon
times your Cursed Energy modifier in necrotic damage. On a success,
they take half as much (Eg. Greatsword with a +3 CE modifier would be
2d6 + 3d6 necrotic damage).

ce.name: Improved Cursed Energy Output
ce.text:
As opposed to simply forcing cursed energy into use for your
abilities, you have become far more efficient in their output
resulting in a dramatic boost in power.
● When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy,
you can spend even more additional cursed energy up to your
proficiency bonus.
● Once per turn, you can increase the damage of an attack by your
cursed energy modifier.
● You can choose to shield yourself as a reaction, you can spend
1 CE to reduce damage by three times your Cursed Energy
modifier.

ce.name: Cursed Energy Trait
ce.text:
Your cursed energy has taken on a unique quality, choose one:
Rough. You gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls and +2 bonus to
damage rolls when using your raw cursed energy (such as cursed
strike).
Smooth. You gain a +1 bonus to AC and your walking speed increases by
5 ft. As a reaction to an attack, you can spend 1 CE to gain a bonus
to your AC equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, potentially causing
the attack to miss.
Elemental. Pick a damage type other than radiant or necrotic. When a
feature uses raw cursed energy to deal damage, you can deal that
damage type instead, dealing additional damage equal to your
proficiency bonus.

ce.name: Cursed Energy Trait Mastery
ce.text:
You have mastered the trait peculiar to your energy:
Rough. You gain a bonus to damage rolls using raw cursed energy equal
to 2 + your CE modifier (such as cursed strike). This replaces the
bonus to damage rolls from your Cursed Energy Trait.
Smooth. You reduce bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage by your
CE modifier and your walking speed increases by 10 ft. This replaces
the bonus to walking speed from your Cursed Energy Trait. As a
reaction to an attack for 1 CE, you gain a bonus to AC equal to twice
your CE modifier, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Elemental. Once per turn on a hit imbued with raw cursed energy (eg.
Cursed Strike) or a creature failing a save against your raw cursed
energy (eg. Cursed Energy Slash), they suffer an additional effect.
These effects stack up to your proficiency bonus (if applicable) and
last a number of turns equal to your CE modifier:
● Acid, reduces the target’s AC by 1
● Bludgeoning, ignores resistance to bludgeoning
● Cold, reduces movement by 10 ft
● Fire, target takes an extra 2 fire damage from your cursed
energy
● Force, target is knocked back 10 ft
● Lightning, the target cannot take reactions
● Piercing, ignores resistance to piercing
● Poison, target gains the Poisoned condition
● Psychic, target gains the frightened condition
● Slashing, ignores resistance to slashing
● Thunder, target is knocked Prone and Deafened

ce.name: Cursed Projectiles
ce.prereq: Proficiency in a Ranged or Thrown weapon
ce.text:
You have learned to imbue your cursed energy into projectiles such as
arrows, bolts or any other type of ammunition or weapon with the
thrown property. As an action, you can imbue a number of projectiles
up to your Cursed Energy modifier, turning them into Cursed
Projectiles until you finish a long rest. When using Cursed
Projectiles, you make ranged Cursed Energy attacks instead of what
you would normally use to attack with them, and you control their
trajectory while in the air, making it so that attacks with them
ignore half and three quarters cover.
Additionally, on a miss they will stay in the air floating for a
number of rounds equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, allowing you
to keep making attacks with them even after being shot or thrown
until they hit a solid object or target. You can use a bonus action
to cause each active Cursed Projectile to make another ranged Cursed
Energy attack against a creature within 60 feet. You can control a
number of Cursed Projectiles equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. A
creature can attack your Cursed Projectiles to destroy them; they
have 1 hit point and an AC equal to your Cursed Technique DC.

ce.name: One In A Billion
ce.text:
Your cursed energy manipulation is some of the best that the world
has ever seen, it must take at least a couple of centuries for
another person such as yourself to be born once again. You gain the
following benefits:
● If a feature deals damage you can reroll all 1s and 2s on
damage dice, and once per long rest you can deal maximum
damage.
● Once per long rest, you can choose one feature that requires
Cursed Energy. The cost of that feature is lowered to 0, if a
feature depends on how much Cursed Energy you spend, it counts
as if you used the maximum required. For example, reverse
cursed technique would heal 50 with a modifier of +5.

ce.name: Pact Maker
ce.text:
You have specialized in the intricacies of binding vows, causing you
to understand their innate workings. You can now make a number of
binding vows equal to twice your proficiency bonus.

ce.name: Chanting
ce.text:
You can set a recitation of chanting for one of your innate technique
features. You recite your chant as a full turn action and must
concentrate until the technique is released. If you lose
concentration, the cursed energy spent on the technique is wasted.
When you use the technique on your next turn after reciting your
chant, it will be given the following boost:
● Your technique will ignore resistances and treat immunities as
resistance.
● If your Innate Technique feature is an attack, it gains
advantage on the attack roll. If it instead requires a saving
throw, the target(s) make their saves at disadvantage.
● Your Technique feature deals double the damage dice.
If your Innate Technique does not directly deal damage, you can
choose the following options:
● The technique's range doubles.
● The technique can target an additional number of creatures
equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.
● You can double the duration of the Innate Technique feature.
If your Innate Technique feature that benefits from Chanting requires
more than one attack roll or save to be made, only the first gains
the benefits of Chanting. You cannot use Maximum Output or Domain
Expansion while Chanting.

ce.name: Blessed by Black Sparks
ce.text:
The sparks of black have chosen you to receive their blessings. You
gain a +3 bonus to your Black Flash range.

ce.name: Shikigami Specialist
ce.prereq: Must be able to summon shikigami
ce.text:
You have specialized in shikigami and made it your life. Choose one
type of shikigami you can summon to be your special. You have a
number of Ability points equal to twice your proficiency bonus that
you can use to increase the ability score of that shikigami (up to a
max of 20). Additionally, you can command any of your shikigami as a
free action on your turn. This does not let you command a shikigami
multiple times per turn. If you have multiple shikigami, you can swap
your special shikigami as part of a long rest.

physical.name: Athlete
physical.text:
You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following
benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of
20.
● When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your
movement.
● Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.
● You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after
moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

physical.name: Charger
physical.text:
When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make
one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature. If you move at least
10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus
action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack’s damage roll (if
you chose to make a melee attack and hit) or push the target up to 10
feet away from you (if you chose to shove and you succeed).

physical.name: Defensive Duelist
physical.text:
When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient
and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your
reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack,
potentially causing the attack to miss you.

physical.name: Dual Wielder
physical.text:
You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following
benefits:
● You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate
melee weapon in each hand.
● You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one handed melee
weapons you are wielding aren't light.
● You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would
normally be able to draw or stow only one.

physical.name: Durable
physical.text:
Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:
● Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum
number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your
Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

physical.name: Crusher
physical.text:
You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies, granting you
the following benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of
20.
● Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that
deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an
unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size
larger than you.
● When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to
a creature, attack rolls against that creature are made with
advantage until the start of your next turn.

physical.name: Fighting Initiate
physical.text:
Your martial training has helped you develop a particular style of
fighting. As a result, you learn one Fighting Style option of your
choice from the fighter class. If you already have a style, the one
you choose must be different.
Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement
feature, you can replace this feat's fighting style with another one
from the fighter class that you don't have.

physical.name: Grappler
physical.text:
You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in
close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:
● You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are
grappling.
● You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by
you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you
and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

physical.name: Great Weapon Master
physical.text:
You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage,
letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following
benefits:
● On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon
or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one
melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
● Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are
proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the
attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's
damage.

physical.name: Heavy Armor Master
physical.text:
You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others.
You gain the following benefits, on top of Heavy armor proficiency:
● Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and
slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is
reduced by 3.

physical.name: Lightly Armored
physical.text:
You have trained to master the use of light armor, gaining the
following benefits.
● Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of
20.
● You gain proficiency with light armor.

physical.name: Martial Adept
physical.text:
You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat
maneuvers. You gain the following benefits.
You learn two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to
the Battle Master archetype in the fighter class. If a maneuver you
use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the
maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency
bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
You gain one superiority die, which is a d6 (this die is added to any
superiority dice you have from another source). This die is used to
fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it.
You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or
long rest.

physical.name: Medium Armor Master
physical.text:
You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following
benefits, on top of proficiency with medium armor:
● Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your
Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
● When you wear medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to
your AC if you have a Dexterity of 16 or higher.

physical.name: Mobile
physical.text:
You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following
benefits:
● Your speed increases by 10 feet.
● When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn't cost
you extra movement on that turn.
● When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't
provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of
the turn, whether you hit or not.

physical.name: Piercer
physical.text:
You have achieved a penetrating precision in combat, granting you
the following benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that
deals piercing damage, you can re-roll one of the attack’s
damage dice, and you must use the new roll.
● When you score a critical hit that deals piercing damage to a
creature, you can roll one additional damage die when
determining the extra piercing damage the target takes.

physical.name: Polearm Master
physical.text:
You gain the following benefits:
● When you take the Attack action and attack with only a glaive,
halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to
make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. This
attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack.
The weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4, and it deals
bludgeoning damage.
● While you are wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff,
or spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from
you when they enter the reach you have with that weapon.

physical.name: Resilient
physical.text:
Choose one ability score. You gain the following benefits:
● Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

physical.name: Savage Attacker
physical.text:
Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you
can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

physical.name: Shield Master
physical.text:
You use shields not just for protection but also for offense. You
gain the following benefits while you are wielding a shield:
● If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus
action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with
your shield.
● If you aren't incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus
to any Dexterity saving throw you make against a spell or other
harmful effect that targets only you.
● If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a
Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use
your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving
throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source
of the effect.

physical.name: Slasher
physical.text:
You've learned where to cut to have the greatest results, granting
you the following benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals
slashing damage, you can reduce the speed of the target by 10
feet until the start of your next turn.
● When you score a critical hit that deals slashing damage to a
creature, you grievously wound it. Until the start of your next
turn, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls.

physical.name: Tavern Brawler
physical.text:
Accustomed to the rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons
happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1 (max of 20).
● You are proficient with improvised weapons.
● When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised
weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to
grapple the target.

physical.name: Tough
physical.text:
Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your
level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter,
your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

skill.name: 2000 IQ
skill.text:
You can make an Intelligence (Arcana) check as a bonus action while
viewing a technique in play to understand how it works. The DC is
equal to the user’s Cursed Energy save DC.
When making this check, treat your Intelligence score as a 22. If you
instead spend a full turn action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement)
attempting to understand a technique, you have advantage on the
check.

skill.name: Actor
skill.text:
Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits:
● Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● You have an advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma
(Performance) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a
different person.
● You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made
by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or
heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A
successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma
(Deception) check allows a listener to determine that the
effect is faked.

skill.name: Alert
skill.text:
Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:
● You can't be surprised while you are conscious.
● You gain a +5 bonus to initiative.
● Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against
you as a result of being unseen by you.

skill.name: Chef
skill.text:
Time and effort spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off. You
gain the following benefits:
● Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum
of 20.
● You gain proficiency with cook’s utensils if you don’t already
have it.
● As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided
you have ingredients and cook's utensils on hand. You can
prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to
4 + your proficiency bonus. At the end of the short rest, any
creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to
regain hit points regains an extra 1d8 hit points.
● With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can
cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus. These
special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can
use a bonus action to eat one of those treats to gain temporary
hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

skill.name: Elemental Adept
skill.text:
● When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage
types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.
● Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type.
In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that
deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die
as a 2.
● You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so,
you must choose a different damage type.

skill.name: Gunner
skill.text:
You have a quick hand and keen eye when employing firearms, granting
you the following benefits:
● Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● You gain proficiency with firearms (see “Firearms” in the
Dungeon Master’s Guide).
● You ignore the loading property of firearms.
● Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose
disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

skill.name: Healer
skill.text:
You are an able physician, allowing you to mend wounds quickly and
get your allies back in the fight. You gain the following benefits:
● When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, that
creature also regains 1 hit point.
● As an action. you can spend one use of a healer's kit to tend
to a creature and restore 1d6 + 4 hit points to it, plus
additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of
Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this feat
again until it finishes a short or long rest.

skill.name: Inspiring Leader
skill.text:
You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, shoring up their
resolve to fight. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures
(which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or
hear you and who can understand you. Each creature can gain temporary
hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier. A creature
can't gain temporary hit points from this feat again until it has
finished a short or long rest.

skill.name: Keen Mind
skill.text:
You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with
uncanny precision. You gain the following benefits.
● Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● You always know which way is north.
● You always know the number of hours left before the next
sunrise or sunset.
● You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard
within the past month.

skill.name: Linguist
skill.text:
You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits:
● Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
● You learn three languages of your choice.
● You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a
code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an
Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your
proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.

skill.name: Mounted Combatant
skill.text:
You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted. While you are mounted
and aren't incapacitated, you gain the following benefits:
● You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted
creature that is smaller than your mount.
● You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you
instead.
● If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make
a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead
takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only
half damage if it fails.

skill.name: Observer
skill.text:
Quick to notice details of your environment, you gain the following
benefits:
● Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum
of 20.
● If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a
language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying by
reading its lips.
● You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom (Perception) and
passive Intelligence (Investigation) scores.

skill.name: Poisoner
skill.text:
You can prepare and deliver deadly poisons, gaining the following
benefits:
● When you use poison, you ignore resistance to poison damage.
● You can coat a weapon in poison as a bonus action, instead of
an action.
● You gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit if you don't
already have it. With one hour of work using a poisoner's kit
and expending 50 gp worth of materials, you can create a number
of doses of potent poison equal to your proficiency bonus. Once
applied to a weapon or piece of ammunition, the poison retains
its potency for 1 minute or until you hit with the weapon or
ammunition. When a creature takes damage from the coated weapon
or ammunition, that creature must succeed on a DC 14
Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 poison damage and become
poisoned until the end of your next turn.

skill.name: Sharpshooter
skill.text:
You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find
impossible. You gain the following benefits:
● Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your
ranged weapon attack rolls.
● Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half and three-quarters
cover.
● Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are
proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the
attack roll. If that attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's
damage.

skill.name: Sorcerer Killer
skill.text:
You have practiced techniques in melee combat against sorcerers,
gaining the following benefits:
● When a creature within 10 feet of you uses Cursed Energy, you
can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against
that creature if they are within range.
● You have advantage on saving throws against cursed techniques
made by creatures within 15 feet of you.

skill.name: Sentinel
skill.text:
You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any
enemy's guard, gaining the following benefits.
● When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the
creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.
● Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they
take the Disengage action before leaving your reach.
● When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a
target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat),
you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against
the attacking creature.

skill.name: Skill Expert
skill.text:
You have honed your proficiency with particular skills, granting you
the following benefits:
● Increase one ability score of your choice by 1 (maximum of 20).
● You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
● Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain
expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus
is doubled for any ability check you make with it. The skill
you choose must be one that isn't already benefiting from a
feature, such as Expertise, that doubles your proficiency
bonus.

skill.name: Skilled
skill.text: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

skill.name: Skulker
skill.text:
You are an expert at slinking through shadows. You gain the following
benefits:
● You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the
creature from which you are hiding.
● When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged
weapon attack, making the attack doesn't reveal your position.
● Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom
(Perception) checks relying on sight.

skill.name: Tavern Brawler
skill.text:
Accustomed to the rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons
happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum
of 20.
● You are proficient with improvised weapons.
● Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage.
● When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised
weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to
grapple the target.

skill.name: Tool Maker
skill.prereq: 16+ Cursed Energy score, Proficiency in Arcana
skill.text:
You have the unique ability to create cursed tools. The time it takes
to make a cursed tool depends on the rarity of the item, and the
rarity of item you can make is dependent on your level and you can
spend 8 hours per day working on a cursed tool. After creating a
cursed tool, you must wait an amount of time equal to its crafting
time before working on another cursed tool. The GM decides the cost
of any materials.
Level 1-4: Fourth Grade (Common)
Time: 72 hours
Level 5-8: Third Grade (Uncommon)
Time: 216 hours
Level 9-12: Second Grade (Rare)
Time: 648 hours
Level 13-16: First Grade (Very Rare)
Time: 1944 hours

skill.name: Weapon Expert
skill.text:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining
the following benefits:
● Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of
20.
● You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one
must be a simple or a martial weapon.
